name: median3_rec
declaration: unsafe fn median3_rec < T , F : FnMut (& T , & T) -> bool > (mut a : * const T , mut b : * const T , mut c : * const T , n : usize , is_less : & mut F ,) -> * const T
documentation:
Calculates an approximate median of 3 elements from sections a, b, c, or
 recursively from an approximation of each, if they're large enough. By
 dividing the size of each section by 8 when recursing we have logarithmic
 recursion depth and overall sample from f(n) = 3*f(n/8) -> f(n) =
 O(n^(log(3)/log(8))) ~= O(n^0.528) elements.

 SAFETY: a, b, c must point to the start of initialized regions of memory of
 at least n elements.
rules: For safety, a must point to the start of an initialized region of memory containing at least n elements of type T.
For safety, b must point to the start of an initialized region of memory containing at least n elements of type T.
For safety, c must point to the start of an initialized region of memory containing at least n elements of type T.
